high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a Reddit post discussing why Darkseid respects Batman but not Superman. The post is authored by a user named Dr. Fate, who is identified as an "Agent of the Lords of Order" and posted on April 14. The text in the post explains that Darkseid respects Batman because he is human with strategic thinking and technological abilities that are comparable to Batman's. The author emphasizes that this aspect of Batman's character is something worth noting. Below the text, there is a comic book panel featuring Batman.
